subject.title: fix(heartbeat-runner): add wakeGuard pre-flight hook to skip no-op wakes (OME-332)

question: Should heartbeat eligibility for external ticket queues and stored assignees be implemented by the owning orchestration integration, or should OpenClaw maintain a generic `wakeGuard` contract in core?
rationale: The PR introduces a new core runtime hook for policy data that is not owned or supplied by the current heartbeat path; selecting the permanent owner boundary is a product and architecture decision, not a mechanical patch repair.

options.title: Keep eligibility integration-owned
options.body: Implement the ticket and assignee check in the orchestration integration without adding an unused core callback.

options.title: Sponsor a generic core seam
options.body: Define the callback contract, failure behavior, production owner, tests, and upgrade expectations before revising this PR.

recommendation.title: Keep eligibility integration-owned
recommendation.body: Implement the ticket and assignee check in the orchestration integration without adding an unused core callback.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author documented the external orchestration use case and is the only identified person connected to this proposed integration boundary.
